description: Campaign 032 ownership record. The orchestrator owns governance, OpenSpec, evidence, generated/catalog contracts, and final convergence. Product packets are disjoint and limited to Games discovery, shared game identity presentation, and focused tests.

parallelPackets.objective: Implement the shared, restrained game-identity metadata and presentation seam for the full 42-game catalog, and update GameCard to expose the identity without changing game definitions, registry generation, or gameplay.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: All 42 registry IDs have deterministic identity metadata spanning the eight required families; GameCard renders identity and preserves existing navigation/favorite/mastery semantics; focused identity tests pass.
parallelPackets.integrationRequirements: Report changed files and any required orchestrator integration; do not edit shared governance, registry, SDK, catalog, or game files.

parallelPackets.objective: Restructure the Games screen around one Suggested Next model and a clear Browse All section, consolidating existing recommendation evidence while preserving search, filters, favorites, lazy loading, and offline data behavior.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Default, search, category, favorite-empty/populated, no-results, light/dark, and offline states expose one primary Suggested Next area followed by Browse All with clear reset behavior; existing recommendation logic remains the source of evidence and no competing peer shelves render.
parallelPackets.integrationRequirements: Coordinate only through existing GameCard and discovery-data contracts; preserve stable test IDs where useful and report any orchestrator-only follow-up.

parallelPackets.objective: Add focused Game Detail regression coverage for the identity-first first viewport, dominant Play action, history ordering, and preserved favorite/mastery/session behavior without changing game mechanics.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Focused tests make the identity/mechanic/Play-before-history contract executable and assert unknown-game fallback remains safe.
parallelPackets.integrationRequirements: Tests must use existing router/database mocking seams and must not add persistence or native dependencies.
